entries.0cf9deb957ff850f: This business proposes products and services that meet current needs, such as the estimate and billing management cloud tool 'Goolip' for the construction industry and large-format printers, to a wide range of industries. It started in October 2024 to act as a driver for 2.4th-sector type enterprises. Revenue for the fiscal year ended September 2025 was ¥49 million.
entries.18f38959f7d6af70: This segment is positioned as a BtoC business and, for individuals and corporations, manufactures and sells specialty-function tatami, arranges tatami installation work, installs solar power generation systems, and operates an electricity sales business. Revenue from external customers for the fiscal year ended September 2025 was ¥745 million. It consists of the Consumer Business, the Solar Energy Business and the Electricity Sales Business.
entries.1f206f7af1b53c2e: This business plans, develops and sells automation systems that use waterjet technology and robotics technology. Its main products are labor-saving manufacturing systems, and its main markets are the automotive industry and the housing equipment-related industry.
entries.2e57c64272d64ec0: This business sells interior finishing equipment, tools and materials, such as automatic wallpaper pasting machines, tape for interior work and floor covering removal machines, through agents for interior finishing contractors and to markets such as home centers, construction equipment rental and waterproofing, etc. Revenue for the fiscal year ended September 2025 was ¥6,199 million.
entries.47020513b0942538: A company that manufactures and sells specialized machines that automate and save labor in craftsmen's manual work, such as automatic wallpaper pasting machines and computerized tatami manufacturing systems.
entries.58f40124fb225bfb: This business installs solar power generation facilities at several company-owned sites, including the mega solar power plant 'Mikazuki Sunshine Park' (output approximately 1 megawatt) in Sayo-chō, Sayo-gun, Hyogo Prefecture, and sells the electricity. Revenue for the fiscal year ended September 2025 was ¥53 million.
entries.7fe349e38c063bbd: This business sells industrial and household solar power generation systems and storage batteries, etc., and performs interior and exterior renovation work. Revenue for the fiscal year ended September 2025 was ¥111 million.
entries.861f8814795a7f5a: This segment covers ROSECC Co., Ltd., which became a subsidiary on October 1, 2020. The company is a fabless company that plans, develops and sells various automation systems using waterjet technology and robotics technology, mainly for the automotive industry. Revenue from external customers for the fiscal year ended September 2025 was ¥844 million.
entries.97bea4048492e39e: This business sells specialty-function tatami, such as funeral tatami, judo tatami and bath tatami, and soundproofing and vibration-damping flooring for fitness clubs, and arranges tatami resurfacing and fusuma replacement work for households through JA and other outlets in various regions. Revenue for the fiscal year ended September 2025 was ¥579 million.
entries.a023abf72d282b81: This business develops in-house various food equipment for commercial kitchens, such as multi-dispensers for miso soup, udon and soba, etc., and sells it to food service chains, etc. Revenue for the fiscal year ended September 2025 was ¥366 million.
entries.b17fa6d5bbb0d3a2: This segment manufactures and sells interior finishing equipment and tools and tatami production equipment, and sells estimate and billing management cloud services and digital printers, etc., for interior finishing contractors and tatami shops. Revenue from external customers for the fiscal year ended September 2025 was ¥6,752 million, accounting for 70.6% of consolidated revenue. It consists of the Interior Business, the Tatami Business, and the Solution & Network Business.
entries.e50fccecb243e689: Restaurants such as food service chains
entries.e7a44b14bf4e2381: Users of the Interior Business and Tatami Business
entries.f33a7f692bcb922f: This business designs, develops and manufactures secondary battery production equipment and various other industrial machinery, etc., based on customer requirements. Revenue for the fiscal year ended September 2025 was ¥860 million.
entries.f463b5d8dfe9e653: Interior finishing materials wholesalers (interior finishing contractors)
entries.f566b465ec0e5ba1: This segment manufactures factory production equipment made to customer specifications and dispensers for restaurants, etc., for corporate customers. Revenue from external customers for the fiscal year ended September 2025 was ¥1,227 million. It consists of the Industrial Equipment Business and the Food Equipment Business.
entries.fc21de284c1a7cb3: This business sells tatami production equipment, such as computerized tatami production systems, and related tools and auxiliary materials to tatami shops. It also offers a 'structural reform proposal' that proposes modernizing tatami shop management through the introduction of tatami production systems. Revenue for the fiscal year ended September 2025 was ¥503 million.
